free_fit.title: Rotclimate Free-Fit Atlas
free_fit.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · every setting fitted freely to your painted zones
free_fit.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
free_fit.note: World and physics fitted to your map together, every setting free at once: reversed spin, 34.1°N, 21.6° tilt, with Sverdrup sinking, narrow subtropical highs, a short circulation lag, short-range storm moisture, convective rain and rain that needs lifting air. Not constrained by real Earth climates.

earth_physics.title: Rotclimate Earth-Physics Atlas
earth_physics.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · physics that also reproduces real Earth climates
earth_physics.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
earth_physics.note: Physics fitted on six real regions (California, Iberia, south-east US, Levant, Central Asia, East China) and only allowed to drift slightly while matching your map; reversed spin. It gets the Mediterranean band right but cannot make the painted cold-dry north dry.
